reason: I'd sign up for the no-card trial on day one, because that's what I do, but I wouldn't pay. I've moved my whole setup into an all-in-one app three times and drifted back to Gmail and my calendar within a month, and $12 on top of what I already pay only makes sense if I actually drop something.
objection: I won't stick with it. Replacing email, calendar, notes and tasks all at once is a big switch, and when a client email lands while I'm at the café I'll open Gmail out of habit, so the client view never fills up enough to be worth it.
would_change_my_mind: If after two weeks the client view had really saved me from digging through four apps before a client call, and I could cancel my separate task and notes apps so it doesn't cost me more overall.
